name: GenManip-Dataset-OOC_Bench
description: A benchmark for evaluating out-of-context/generalization robustness to generated or manipulated content (OOC = out-of-context). It measures models' ability to detect or correctly handle content that has been synthetically altered or presented in atypical contexts, emphasizing generalization beyond in-distribution examples. The dataset is intended to stress-test models on realistic manipulation scenarios and evaluate detection or correction strategies.
reputation: A relatively new, specialized benchmark with limited but growing use among researchers focusing on misinformation and manipulation detection.
